segments.an5.35:1.6: gihidhammā anapagato [gihidhammā anapeto (sī. pī.), gihidhammamanupagato (ka.)] hoti;
segments.an5.35:1.7: kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati.
segments.an5.35:1.8: Ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca dāne ānisaṃsā”ti.
segments.an5.35:2.3: Santo naṃ sadā bhajanti [santo bhajanti sappurisā (sī.)], saññatā brahmacārayo.
segments.an5.35:3.3: Yaṃ so dhammaṃ idhaññāya, parinibbāti anāsavo”ti.

lines: Sataṃ dhammaṃ anukkamanti sappurisānaṃ mahāpurisānaṃ dhammaṃ anukkamanto.
Santo naṃ bhajantīti sappurisā buddhapaccekabuddhatathāgatasāvakā etaṃ bhajanti.
